text: This report outlines the revised accessibility program at Exhibition Place and recommends the approval of revised Accessibility Policy attached as Appendix A and the new Multi-Year (2019 - 2025) Accessibility Plan attached as Appendix B. Exhibition Place is required pursuant to the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA) to have accessibility policies governing how the organization achieves accessibility and meets legislated requirements. Exhibition Place first adopted its Accessibility Policy in 2010. Recently, City of Toronto Council approved a corporate policy and Exhibition Place has reviewed its existing policy in light of the City benchmark and are proposing revisions in line with the City's. Following approval of the 2010 policy, Exhibition Place also approved a Multi-Year (2013 - 2018) Accessibility Plan that has guided our organization in meeting or…

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the revised Accessibility Policy attached as Appendix A to the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place. 2. Approved the Multi-Year Accessibility Plan (2019-2025) attached as Appendix B to the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place.
